Class MesosServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.network.server.MesosServer
public class MesosServer extends Object
Central, transport-agnostic hub for broadcasting notifications to connected clients.

MesosServer maintains a single map from player nickname to VirtualView, regardless of whether the underlying connection is a Socket (SocketClientHandler) or RMI (RmiViewAdapter). Both RmiServer and SocketClientHandler register their clients here via registerClient(String, VirtualView), and call the broadcast* methods after executing a player action so that every relevant client receives the update through whichever transport it is connected with.

By design, MesosServer has no dependency on GameManager or any other model class: it only knows nicknames and VirtualView references, keeping the networking layer decoupled from game logic.

Thread safety: connectedPlayers is a ConcurrentHashMap, since multiple client-handling threads (one per Socket connection, plus RMI calls) register, unregister, and read from it concurrently.

  • Method Details

    • registerClient

      public void registerClient(String nickname, VirtualView view)
      Registers a connected client under the given nickname, making it a valid recipient for subsequent broadcast* calls.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's nickname, used as the lookup key
      view - the VirtualView through which notifications will be delivered to this client (a SocketClientHandler or an RmiViewAdapter)

    • broadcastToGame

      public void broadcastToGame(List<String> recipients, GameDelta delta)
      Sends an incremental state update to every recipient in the given list.

      Recipients not currently registered (e.g. already disconnected) are silently skipped. Delivery failures are currently swallowed; the inline comment marks this as the place where disconnect handling could be triggered if needed.

      Parameters:
      recipients - the nicknames of the players to notify (typically all players in a game)
      delta - the state update to deliver

    • broadcastSnapshotToGame

      public void broadcastSnapshotToGame(List<String> recipients, GameSnapshot snapshot)
      Sends a full game snapshot to every recipient in the given list.

      Used when a game starts (all players receive the initial snapshot at once) and when a player reconnects after a server crash. Recipients not currently registered are silently skipped.

      Parameters:
      recipients - the nicknames of the players to notify
      snapshot - the full game state to deliver

    • broadcastErrorToGame

      public void broadcastErrorToGame(List<String> recipients, String message)
      Sends an error message to every recipient in the given list.

      Used in particular to notify the remaining players ("companions") when one player disconnects and their shared game is terminated. Recipients not currently registered, or already disconnected themselves, are silently skipped.

      Parameters:
      recipients - the nicknames of the players to notify
      message - the human-readable error/notification text

    • unregisterClient

      public void unregisterClient(String nickname)
      Removes a client's registration, freeing its nickname so that another client can later join using the same nickname.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname to remove from the registry
